title: France is Europe's private tech capital
blurb: Seven French private tech firms now valued above $5B. Mistral AI is the standout — $13.8B at a 34.5× revenue multiple.
body:
After Mistral AI's mega VC round in late 2025, France quietly became home to seven private tech companies valued above $5B. The top 10 (as of Apr 2026):

  • Dassault Systèmes — $28.0B · 3.8× · Public
  • Mistral AI — $13.8B · 34.5× · Private (the AI standout)
  • Doctolib — $6.4B · 15.1×
  • Back Market — $5.7B · 13.7×
  • ContentSquare — $5.6B · 17.0×
  • Verkor — $5.6B
  • Alan — $5.5B · 2.0×
  • Edenred — $5.3B · 1.5× · Public
  • Qonto — $5.0B · 9.7×
  • Webhelp — $4.9B · Acquired

Mistral's 34.5× revenue multiple dwarfs the field — the premium the market puts on a European frontier-model lab.

SOURCE · Multiples.vc, "France is Europe's private tech capital."
